definitions.explanation: The nutritive substances contained in food, soil, or other materials. More technical than {栄養|えいよう} alone — it refers to the constituent nutrient components rather than nutrition as a whole concept.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This vegetable is high in nutrients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: The nutrients in the soil support plant growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{加工食品|かこうしょくひん}→加工食品：06605_kakoushokuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失|うしな}われ→失う：01887_ushinau⟧やすい。
examples.english: Processed foods tend to lose nutrients during the cooking process.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧ (nutrition) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (portion, component). Refers to specific nutritive components such as vitamins, minerals, proteins, and fats. Common in cooking, agriculture, and biology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: high in nutrients
- {栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂|と}る→摂る：29372_toru⟧: to take in nutrients
- {栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する→吸収する：25365_kyuushuusuru⟧: to absorb nutrients
- {栄養分|えいようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: rich in nutrients

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧: nutrition — the broader concept; can also mean 'nutrients' in casual usage
- ⟦{栄養素|えいようそ}→栄養素：06207_eiyouso⟧: nutrient (technical) — specific named nutrients in scientific contexts
- {養分|ようぶん}: nutrients — common in botany and agriculture; near-synonym
